content.text:
This is a purely presentational React component for a fake/demo terminal on a marketing page. All content is:
- Static (imported `PROMPT_TEXT`, `RESPONSE_BLOCKS`)
- Rendered through React's default text interpolation (no `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`, no `eval`, no template compilation)
- No user input, no network I/O, no filesystem/shell/DB sinks
- `Math.random()` is used only for cosmetic verb selection and a fake token counter — no security decision reads from it
- Timers are properly cleaned up in effect returns

No entry points, no sinks, no data flow to trace. No findings.
